name: Dublin Library High School Teen Program Proposals
what_you_do: High school students who already have an idea for a free library program can propose it. If picked, you present it in person at the Dublin Library.
who_can_apply: Students in high school with a program idea. Programs must be free, open to the public and non-commercial. You may not sell or promote products or collect attendees' contact info.
duration: One program you lead. Presentation dates are set later.
deadline_text: The fall window closed Oct 19, 2026. The next window is May 17 to June 21, 2027, for programs in October 2027 to January 2028.
how_to_apply: Fill out the library's online Program Proposal form, linked on the event page, before the window closes. A proposal does not guarantee a spot.
notes: The page does not say if presenters are paid; treat it as unpaid. Library programs are booked at least 3 months ahead. The proposal windows open on the third Monday of their months. Questions: dublin@aclibrary.org or (925) 803-7252.
